source.post_text: how much money do I have to make per year to go to a beach that looks like this but with 95% less people

replies.text: Honestly it depends more on flexibility than raw income—plenty of quieter stretches exist in the Canaries or rural Greece if you aim for shoulder season and keep expectations realistic around 50-70k.
